name: perl-log-any
description: Log::Any is a transparent logging interface for Perl that separates log production from log consumption.
overview: Log::Any is a transparent logging interface for Perl that separates log production from log consumption. This skill helps you implement a standardized logging API within CPAN-style modules or private libraries without forcing a specific logging framework (like Log4perl or Log::Dispatch) on the end user. It is particularly useful for ensuring that library code remains "silent" by default while allowing application developers to easily hook into various output destinations.
